title: Mechanical Billing Verification Engineer For Panoli -Gujarat
description:
Dear Candidates, Position: Billing & Verification Engineer
 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. – Mechanical Engineering
 Experience: 7–10 Years
 Industry: Process 
 Location: Panoli Job Description: Responsible for verification and certification of contractor/vendor bills based on actual site execution, approved BOQ, drawings, specifications and contractual requirements. Key Responsibilities Verify RA Bills, Final Bills, Measurement Sheets and supporting documents . Check executed quantities against BOQ, approved drawings, specifications and site measurements . Verify rates, quantities, deductions, variations, extra items and deviations. Coordinate with Site, Construction, Planning, QA/QC and Commercial teams for bill verification. Conduct site visits to verify actual work executed and measurements. Identify and resolve discrepancies in contractor/vendor bills. Maintain records of certified quantities, pending bills, variations and reconciliation. Prepare billing status and quantity verification reports for management. Ensure timely processing of bills as per project requirements. Multi-Discipline Exposure The candidate should have sufficient technical knowledge to coordinate and verify basic works related to: Mechanical: Equipment, piping, fabrication, erection and associated works. Civil: Foundation, structural, concrete, excavation and other basic civil works. E&I: Cable trays, cable laying, supports, earthing and basic electrical installation. Instrumentation: Instrument installation, tubing, supports and related installation activities. Must-Have Requirements Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering . 7–10 years of relevant experience . Strong experience in billing, quantity verification and site measurement . Good knowledge of BOQ, RA Bills, measurement sheets and variation/deviation claims . Ability to read and understand engineering drawings and specifications . Good working knowledge of MS Excel . Experience in EPC / Oil & Gas / Power / Process / Industrial Projects preferred. Should be capable of independently handling billing verification at site/project level. Good coordination, communication and documentation skills. Good-to-Have Exposure to Civil, Electrical & Instrumentation works . Experience in multi-discipline EPC projects. Knowledge of contractual/commercial terms related to project billing. Experience in handling multiple contractors/vendors. Interested candidates can share their cv at apeksha.pagedar@isspl.com

Key Skills: Site,Construction,Qa/Qc,Specifications,Boq, approved drawings,Planning,Mechanical
